task.summary: Introduce/finish src/api/** and src/shared/** facades, move primitive shared ports/helpers, and remove residual src/domain/** and src/application/** owner paths after concept roots land.

goal.outcome: Stable API/shared facade exists and residual layer-first owner paths are removed or explicitly documented as temporary compatibility shims with guard coverage.
